_note: Recorded live, verbatim. Do not hand-edit or trim: four bugs in this repo shipped behind fixtures that shared the code blind spot.

nfl-regular-season.why: NFL current season. categories[].splitType is the string "2".

nfl-prior-season.why: A completed NFL season reached via ?season=. Carries BOTH a Postseason and a Regular Season seasonType, and lists Postseason FIRST — order is not a signal.

nba-preseason-and-months.why: NBA season=2026 is the 2025-26 season (ENDING year, unlike NFL). Its regular-season categories are MONTHS ("april", splitType "april"), so a splitType==="2" filter returns nothing at all; and a Preseason seasonType shares the same flat events map.

nfl-unknown-athlete-404.why: A bad athlete id answers 404, not 200-with-empty — so a bad ROW is distinguishable from a bad PAGE.

_reduction: Two UNIFORM transformations applied to every recorded body, and nothing else: (1) every 'links' array is truncated to its first element — the parser reads links[0].href as a human-verifiable source URL, so the field's shape is preserved, only its repetition is dropped; (2) the top-level 'glossary' key is removed, being display text no code path reads. No key was chosen for removal because the parser ignores it, and no structure was flattened: the seasonTypes / categories / events nesting, the month-named NBA categories, the preseason split and the full event objects are all exactly as served.
